01. Brand Foundations

Semantic Color Roles & Surface Hierarchy

Henley rejects stark cold grays and synthetic shadows. Depth is created via warm paper transitions and calibrated contrast ratios.

Canvas Base bg-canvas • #FBF9F6 15.98:1 AAA vs Primary
Surface Raised bg-surface-raised • #F5F3EF 15.15:1 AAA vs Primary
Oxblood (Primary Action) bg-accent • #5C2225 12.28:1 AAA vs White
Saffron (Product Star) bg-saffron • #A6332F 6.37:1 AA vs Canvas
Antique Gold (Foil Only) border-gold • #B08B4F 3.00:1 UI AA Non-Text
Sage (Botanical & Stock) bg-sage • #7F8A6E 8.12:1 AAA (text over pill)
Hairline Neutral border-hairline • #E5DFD6 Structural 1px separator
Surface Dark bg-surface-dark • #1D1714 High contrast sections

Tabbed Content

Delicate notes of Muscatel grape, white peach blossom, and freshly cut Himalayan pine. Pale amber liquor with an effervescent floral finish.

Plucked at Castleton Estate, Kurseong South, at an elevation of 1,800m. Sandy loam soil enriched with oak leaf compost.

Infuse 2.5g in 200ml of mineral spring water at 85°C for exactly 3 minutes. Strain through porcelain filter.

Accordion (Single or Multiple Open)
Keep the porcelain cloche jar sealed tightly in a cool, dry pantry away from direct sunlight and pungent spices.
First flush is harvested during early spring, resulting in light, brisk, floral liquors. Second flush leaves are harvested in summer and yield rich, amber cups with deep muscatel character.
All our grower estates operate strictly under biodynamic standards with zero synthetic pesticides or artificial aroma sprays.
